notes.title: Be the First to Play PLATONICA SPACE at BitSummit the 13th
notes.notes: [p]We’ll be exhibiting a playable demo of [i]PLATONICA SPACE[/i] at the KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO booth during [b]BitSummit the 13th[/b], one of Japan’s largest indie game events held in Kyoto.[/p][p]Please stop by and check it out![/p][p][/p][p][b]Dates:[/b] July 18 (Fri) – July 20 (Sun)[/p][p][b]Booth:[/b] 1F IP1-37[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699215/87f4e6ef50f44f7383f5151cd44953930d194234.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Event Details[/b][/h3][p][b]Friday, July 18[/b] — Business Day (media & industry only): 10:00–17:00[/p][p][b]Saturday–Sunday, July 19–20[/b] — Open to the public: 10:00–17:00[/p][p][/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Miyakomesse (Kyoto International Exhibition Hall)[/p][p][url="https://miyakomesse.jp/access/"]https://miyakomesse.jp/access/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Official Website of “BitSummit the 13th Summer of Yokai”:[/b][/p][p][url="https://bitsummit.org"]https://bitsummit.org[/url][/p][p][/p]
